unreflected_implementations.native_rule: Header+0x41:0 none,1 all body ignoring cap,2 bounded prefix; flag2/cap0 is empty. Unknown flags reject. Full16-byte blocks only.
unreflected_implementations.observed: Flag0x41 is never consulted. cap0 becomes unlimited; writer makes the same wrong assumption. Unknown flag3 is accepted.
unreflected_implementations.recommendation: Pass crypto flag explicitly to shared read/write interval logic; define cap0 by flag rather than a universal sentinel; reject unknown flags.

unreflected_implementations.native_rule: E=floor(min(body,cap)/16)*16 for flag2; cap itself need not be aligned. Observed native reader accepts interval17 with16 encrypted bytes.
unreflected_implementations.observed: Header check rejects cap17 as a FormatError, even before interpreting crypto flag.
unreflected_implementations.recommendation: Round the effective transformed byte count, not the cap. If intentionally restricting profiles, label this Unsupported rather than a universal format rule.

def to_bytes(self, *, rebuild: bool = False, compression_level: int = 6) -> bytes:
        if type(compression_level) is not int or not -1 <= compression_level <= 9:
            raise ValueError('compression_level must be -1 through 9')
        _header_check(self.header)
        if not rebuild and self.unchanged:
            return self._original  # type: ignore[return-value]
        compressed = zlib.compress(bytes(self.payload), compression_level) + bytes(self.trailer)
        n = crypt_length(len(compressed), self.max_crypt_size)
        body = AES.new(KEY, AES.MODE_ECB).encrypt(compressed[:n]) + compressed[n:]
        header = bytearray(self.header)
        put(header, 8, len(header) + len(body), endian='big')
        return bytes(header) + body

unreflected_implementations.observed: Reader always inflates; writer always compresses yet preserves header flag0. The codec can accept its own flag-inconsistent output while the native-rule oracle cannot recover the intended payload.
unreflected_implementations.recommendation: Honor compression flag in both directions, or reject non-supported flag profiles before accepting/rebuilding; never emit compressed bytes under an unchanged zero flag.

unreflected_implementations.native_rule: Outer fields BE; header+0x52 nonzero means inner LE, zero means inner BE, including integer prefixes and UTF16 byte order.
unreflected_implementations.observed: All record primitives/serialization assume LE. Header+0x52 is not checked; a contradictory LE body with flag0 passes Library parsing and the semantic-profile guard.
unreflected_implementations.recommendation: Either propagate inner byte order through Node/read/write/text handling, or fail closed for flag0 at intake and semantic write boundaries until BE is implemented.

unreflected_implementations.native_rule: Encoding3 zero-extends each byte to a Unicode unit: Latin1-equivalent, not UTF8.
unreflected_implementations.observed: Caf e9 is rejected as invalid UTF8. c3 a9 silently becomes U+00E9 instead of native U+00C3 U+00A9. This also affects track/index text-key operations via shared read_text. New non-ASCII writes choose encoding1, which is a valid alternative and is not itself the bug.
unreflected_implementations.recommendation: Map3 to latin-1; retain encoding1 with the selected inner byte order; add accent and UTF8-lookalike fixtures.

unreflected_implementations.native_rule: Encoding2 semantics were not established by the static analysis.
unreflected_implementations.observed: Global encoding2=ASCII mapping and forced encoding2 for URL writes treat an unproven meaning as known. This audit does not prove ASCII instances incompatible.
unreflected_implementations.recommendation: Preserve encoding2 opaquely/refuse semantic changes unless the dynamic owner supplies explicit type/profile evidence. Scope any verified ASCII subset narrowly rather than claiming global encoding2 semantics.

advisories.native_rule: mith+0x2bc and+0x2bf are distinct one-byte stores. Static analysis alone did not establish all loved semantics.
advisories.observed: The code uses a32-bit word at+0x2bc, but mask0x02000000 affects only bit0x02 of byte+0x2bf on LE. Sentinel test preserves2bc/2bd/2be and all other2bf bits. Do NOT report this current mask as observed adjacent-byte corruption.
advisories.recommendation: Prefer explicit one-byte access at+0x2bf with mask0x02 and preserve+0x2bc independently. Keep the semantic label tied to separate native dynamic evidence.
